qolFindings.title: At 320 px and 200% text, the new '.txt' explanation line sits under the bottom bar after preparing
qolFindings.evidence: CourseFiles.tsx reveals the prepared block with block 'nearest'. At 200% the block is taller than the space above the bar, so the browser aligns its top: the status with its check icon is at y=0 and Condividi ends at 488 with the bar top at 490. The muted line 'Condividi invia lo stesso corso come file .txt: si importa come il file salvato.' is left behind the translucent bar (test-results/field-ux-r7/iphone-13-webkit-320-200-2-after-prepare.png). The line is secondary information and one scroll shows it, so this is not a blocker.

qolFindings.title: Identical repeated feedback is not revealed again
qolFindings.evidence: CourseFiles.tsx: the reveal effect depends on [exportError, shareError, shareMessage]. A second tap on Salva file calls setShareMessage with the same string, so the state does not change, the effect does not re-run, and a user who scrolled away gets no visible reaction. Found by reading the code; not driven in the browser.
qolFindings.reproduction: Code reading: downloadExport sets shareError to null and shareMessage to the unchanged 'Salvataggio avviato…'.

resolvedFindings.disposition: Fixed and checked independently by re-running my unchanged round-6 probe against df1b9d0, with Prepara scrolled to 8 px above the bar. Pixel 7 at 412 px: the save status is at 719-759 and the share alert at 719-759, with the bar top at 764. The import error after 'Scegli il file del corso' just above the bar is at 739-759. iPhone 13 WebKit at 390 px: save status and alert at 544-584, bar top 589. At 320/200% on both engines: save status 360-480, alert 320-480, import error 360-480, bar top 490. hiddenUnderNav is false and the elements are on screen in every case. In pixel-7-chrome-device-4-share-error.png the red triangle and text are fully readable above the bar.

Fixed. At 320/200% the jump after Prepara is now about 395 px instead of 494 px, and the status lands with its top at the viewport top: the CircleCheck and 'File del corso pronto:' are visible (iphone-13-webkit-320-200-2-after-prepare.png). Salva file at 296-384 and Condividi at 400-488 are both clear of the bar. Focus is on Salva file and :focus-visible is false, so no stray ring after a touch. At device width everything stays visible: Pixel status 567-607 and Salva 615-659; iPhone status 372-432 and Salva 440-484.

Fixed. Salva file has aria-describedby='prepared-file-status', which I measured on both engines. The new e2e test asserts toHaveAccessibleDescription(/File del corso pronto/). Real TalkBack and VoiceOver output was not observed.
Addressed by the muted line under the buttons (wording is clear; see FU-R7-Q1 for its placement at 200%).
Accepted without change by the orchestrator; no objection.

evidenceInspected: The fix diff 18267f0..df1b9d0 for src/styles.css ([data-reveal] added to the scroll-margin-bottom rule), src/features/settings/CourseFiles.tsx (reveal(), focus with preventScroll, aria-describedby, data-reveal containers, the .txt line) and src/App.tsx (SlowResetHint after 8 s). Also the new 'export feedback stays above the bottom bar (device|320-200)' assertions in tests/e2e/d4-course-files.spec.ts: status, focus, accessible description, save status and share alert must sit within the viewport above the bar.

Node v24.21.0, HEAD df1b9d0. My scratch Playwright run (my scratchpad's r6/r7.spec.ts and r7.config.ts, its own Vite server on port 4191) on Pixel 7 Chromium and iPhone 13 WebKit: 6/6 passed in 1.1 min. It runs the same journeys as round 6, with the import step now tapped from just above the bar and the reset screen held for 9 s.

Measured contrast is unchanged: error text 6.74:1, triangle 6.57:1, ready status 6.43:1, muted status 5.89:1. The error has role=alert and an aria-hidden SVG. scrollWidth equals clientWidth at 412, 390 and 320.

Slow-reset hint: deletion was stubbed to hang. After 8 s the bold line 'Ci vuole più del solito. Chiudi tutte le altre finestre e schede di questa app, anche quelle aperte nel browser: la cancellazione continuerà.' appears under the existing wording, inside the role=status section, with no horizontal overflow at 320/200%. It does not contradict 'se chiudi l'app prima, la cancellazione riprenderà alla prossima apertura'. Closing and reopening still resumes straight into 'Cancellazione dei dati locali…' and completes: 0.8 s on Pixel, 1.9 s on WebKit, then Riapri l'app leads to Crea il corso.
